lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's twenty-five? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 25? Nope!

lines.text: Take three to the sixth, times seven to the fourth, times thirteen squared.
lines.caption: Take 3 to the 6th, times 7 to the 4th, times 13 squared.

lines.text: How many of its positive divisors end in the digit one?
lines.caption: How many of its positive divisors end in the digit 1?

lines.text: Only last digits matter. Here's three to the a, times thirteen to the c.
lines.caption: Only last digits matter. Here's 3 to the a, times 13 to the c.

lines.text: Five boxes end in one. Powers of seven end in one, seven, nine, three, one.
lines.caption: 5 boxes end in 1. Powers of 7 end in 1, 7, 9, 3, 1.

lines.text: A box ending in one works with two of them. Every other box works with exactly one!
lines.caption: A box ending in 1 works with 2 of them. Every other box works with exactly 1!

lines.text: Five times two, plus sixteen. That's twenty-six!
lines.caption: 5 times 2, plus 16. That's 26!

lines.text: Twenty-five was the trap. Seven doesn't end in one!
lines.caption: 25 was the trap. 7 doesn't end in 1!

lines.text: Did you get twenty-six? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 26? Tell me below!
